An Anthology of Joy and Thought Vol. 1

Image: Stephen Noh

dwell

to sit here
  amidst Your presence
    in the stillness
    in the quiet
Your peace overflows in me
  and the noises cease
    no more worries
    no more fears

to talk to You
to talk with You
to listen to You
to be with You
to dwell
may i dwell
…
…
…
and would all else fade away…
